_why: WC-TW-6b. Only rules whose ref starts with managed_ref_prefix are owned by apply.py; any other rule in the phase is left untouched. Later rules override earlier ones, so the bypass rule must stay last. The cookie bypass skips the shell paths on purpose: hashed assets and icons are user-independent, and bypassing them would make logged-in page loads slower than today (Cloudflare already caches /_next/static by extension).

rules.description: WC-TW-6b: edge-cache the static shell (hashed Next assets, fonts, icons, brand marks); edge TTL from origin Cache-Control, browser TTL left to the zone setting
rules.expression: (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/_next/static/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/fonts/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/icons/") or http.request.uri.path in {"/favicon.ico" "/favicon-16x16.png" "/favicon-32x32.png" "/apple-touch-icon.png" "/android-chrome-192x192.png" "/android-chrome-256x256.png" "/android-chrome-384x384.png" "/android-chrome-512x512.png" "/mstile-70x70.png" "/mstile-144x144.png" "/mstile-150x150.png" "/mstile-310x150.png" "/mstile-310x310.png" "/safari-pinned-tab.svg" "/cal-logo-word.svg" "/cal-logo-word-dark.svg" "/cal-logo-word-black.svg" "/calcom-logo-white-word.svg" "/cal-com-icon.svg" "/cal-com-icon-white.svg"})

rules.description: WC-TW-6b: never cache /api/*, /trpc/*, /auth/*, or any non-shell request carrying a session cookie
rules.expression: starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/trpc/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/auth/") or (http.cookie contains "next-auth.session-token" and not (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/_next/static/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/fonts/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/icons/") or http.request.uri.path in {"/favicon.ico" "/favicon-16x16.png" "/favicon-32x32.png" "/apple-touch-icon.png" "/android-chrome-192x192.png" "/android-chrome-256x256.png" "/android-chrome-384x384.png" "/android-chrome-512x512.png" "/mstile-70x70.png" "/mstile-144x144.png" "/mstile-150x150.png" "/mstile-310x150.png" "/mstile-310x310.png" "/safari-pinned-tab.svg" "/cal-logo-word.svg" "/cal-logo-word-dark.svg" "/cal-logo-word-black.svg" "/calcom-logo-white-word.svg" "/cal-com-icon.svg" "/cal-com-icon-white.svg"}))
